stages.removal: Removes fused scene/shot/action/camera planning. Images would need manual plans or another planner; simply removing it breaks automatic directing.
Wrong actors, speakers, weapons or premature actions can pass through to expensive images. Removes text-plan review, not image vision QC.
Loses evidence-backed clothing, injuries, restraints, possession and story-memory updates. Later chapters can contradict the source.
Unsupported or misattributed proposed facts can become permanent state. Saves these review calls but may increase later visual repair costs.
No automatic cast extraction or identity matching. Pre-approved complete cast could replace this call; unnamed people may otherwise be missed.
A flagged plan stays failed/manual-review instead of receiving a bounded automatic fix. Cost falls only on plans that need repair.
Removes the classic story interpretation, beats and continuity proposals. The staged source-fact pass replaces it; dropping both loses structured story memory.
Removes the classic visual prompt supplement. A model-aware compiler still needs structured action/camera decisions; the fused storyboard supplies those.
Removes classic source/shot continuity checking. Separate staged reviews replace it; removing all reviews permits unsupported story state.
Removes scene boundaries and pacing in classic mode. The fused storyboard replaces it; removing both leaves no directed scene plan.
Removes classic shot/action planning. The fused storyboard replaces it; removing both leaves no intentional individual shots.
Flagged source facts remain failed/manual-review. Accepting them without correction would risk false continuity; no saving on unflagged plans.
Removes classic camera/composition decisions. The fused storyboard replaces it; removing both reduces intentional framing.
No AI workflow selection. A validated, explicitly selected fixed provider/workflow could replace this call; model compatibility still needs validation.
